reviews.comment:
La verdad que no se para que tienen una estación de servicios si nunca tienen nafta, cuando estábamos llegando a destino paramos para cargar nafta y no tenían, x suerte llegamos a villa atamisqui con lo poco q tenía de nafta, y los baño la verdad una vergüenza, y a la vuelta también paramos a cargar nafta y tampoco tenían nafta y malisima la contestación de los empleados cuando me bajé a preguntar si tenían nafta o no

(Translated by Google)
Honestly, I don't know why they have a gas station if they never have any fuel. When we were almost at our destination, we stopped to fill up and they didn't have any. Luckily, we made it to Villa Atamisqui with what little fuel I had left. The restrooms were truly shameful. On the way back, we stopped to fill up again and they didn't have any fuel then either. The employees were incredibly rude when I got out to ask if they had any gas or not.
